{
  "name": "txpacket_prepare",
  "confidence": "medium",
  "docstring": "Prepares a TX packet by scanning the packet's encoded header chain for a table-selected protocol/type and copying or nulling the TX-context payload pointer when a match is found.",
  "subsystem": "mac",
  "var_renames": {
    "a1": "tx_packet_info",
    "a2": "tx_context",
    "v2": "packet_flags",
    "v3": "frame_base",
    "v4": "packet_length",
    "v7": "remaining_length",
    "v8": "header_ptr",
    "v9": "protocol_entry",
    "v10": "header_aux_word",
    "v11": "header_length",
    "v12": "header_word",
    "v13": "protocol_id"
  },
  "struct_hints": [
    {"offset": 28, "meaning": "a1 pointer to packet/frame data or buffer descriptor"},
    {"offset": 48, "meaning": "a1 packet total length"},
    {"offset": 84, "meaning": "a1 TX packet flags/status word"},
    {"offset": 12, "meaning": "a2 index selecting the protocol/filter table entry"},
    {"offset": 13, "meaning": "a2 high-nibble protocol/version value compared against header_word"},
    {"offset": 224, "meaning": "a2 output payload pointer, cleared or set to inline buffer"},
    {"offset": 228, "meaning": "a2 inline small payload/header copy buffer"},
    {"offset": 32, "meaning": "protocol table entry expected header/protocol identifier"}
  ]
}
